firmware_tests.scope: Actual firmware with mock hardware APIs; 60 days is simulated, not a hardware soak

color_tests.scope: Synthetic frames: colors, shading, lettering/reflections, background exclusion, ambiguous scenes, red hue wrap and brightness invariance. Real blue/green webcam frames checked locally; images not published.

deployment.user_live_check: User confirmed switching between blue and green works; requested clearer colors. Saturation/gamma adjustment added afterwards.

live_program.color_rendering: Vivid: remove neutral component and apply gamma 2.2; maximum channel 200 before firmware brightness.
